close-knit.description: Close Knit - Neighbourhoods and homes in London and England from official open data: sale prices (HM Land Registry), rents (ONS), crime (police.uk), schools (Ofsted/DfE), flood risk, noise and TfL commute times. Every answer carries its sources. 24 read-only tools plus send_feedback. Free, no sign-in, no API key required.
